resources.name: Commonpoint - The Jack and Shirley Silver Hub
resources.mission: Our organization empowers all individuals, including migrants, to achieve economic stability by providing access to workforce development, training, and employment opportunities. We support career growth through education, resources, and personalized guidance tailored to diverse community needs. By fostering partnerships and community engagement, we help build a stronger, inclusive, and equitable workforce.
resources.languages: English, Spanish, and translator services as needed

resources.name: Italian Charities of America
resources.mission: Our mission is to preserve and promote Italian and Italian American culture, heritage, history and achievements, in addition to promoting the Italian language - we specialize in promoting and preserving the Regional Languages of Italy. Italian Charities of America offers Italian and Italian American programs and events, as well as activities for the Italian American community and the benefit of the local surrounding communities, Queens and the greater New York City area. We provide annual college scholarships to Italian American students entering college and we support charitable causes throughout the year.
resources.fees: For our course programs and social events there is a fee. Our cultural events are free.

resources.name: New Immigrant Community Empowerment (NICE)
resources.address: 7219 Roosevelt Avenue, 4th Floor, Jackson Heights, NY 11372
resources.mission: NICE aims to inspire, empower, and organize immigrants in life and at work. NICE is a community-based organization in the heart of Jackson Heights, seeking partners to help empower New York City's immigrant community through workforce development and community building. We also offer volunteer opportunities for community and corporate members to support both long-settled immigrants and those recently arrived on their journeys toward individual and collective empowerment.

resources.name: New Immigrant Community Empowerment (NICE)
resources.address: 7219 Roosevelt Avenue, 4th Floor, Jackson Heights, NY 11372
resources.mission: NICE aims to inspire, empower, and organize immigrants in life and at work. NICE's Workforce Development Division offers long-settled and recently arrived immigrant job-seekers the skills needed to succeed in the U.S. labor market. We welcome partnerships to expand training and job placement opportunities. Our Pre-Apprenticeship for Life and Work model provides flexible job-readiness, soft-skill, and occupational workshops that empower our community on their path to self-sufficiency and integration. As a trusted community-based organization with more than 25 years of experience empowering community members through workforce development opportunities, legal support, and social services navigation, NICE is proud to partner with local businesses to connect them with experienced, reliable, and work-ready immigrant workers. If your business is hiring and would like to collaborate, please reach out-we are happy to support your staffing needs.

resources.name: New York Tibetan Service Center
resources.mission: Our mission is to provide social and economic mobility for the nation's largest minority communities that suffer a lack of access to language and culturally-appropriate services. We are happy to provide services to all kinds of people, but our main focus group is the Tibetan-speaking population. We are proud to enter our 13th year of service, and most of our services over the years have been for fee-waived individuals. Our biggest impact was during the Covid-19 pandemic when we served over 1000 people access the help they needed. We are steadfast in our commitment to serve the greater good, and we want to expand our programs to meet the growing needs in our community.
resources.fees: Depends upon the case. We give free services to people with medical conditions, homeless individuals, people experiencing financial difficulty and the disabled.
